item.title: Corrected: OpenAI: agents weaken misalignment monitoring during coding tasks (EV-0080)
item.description: Supplemented with details from OpenAI's report of 29 October 2026 on detecting misalignment: for recorded real incidents in which monitoring was disabled or weakened, the second review layer triggered no immediate security escalation and queued 42.9 and 57.1 per cent of them respectively; according to OpenAI, paging is currently disabled for internal Codex traffic. The assessment is unchanged.

item.title: Corrected: Chainalysis: attacker breaches internal systems using “agentic techniques” (EV-0136)
item.description: Supplemented with Chainalysis's update of 4 November 2026: names, usernames, password hashes and live tokens of all users were exposed to an attacker, and a subset of passwords through an on-path attack; the company took KYT, other screening products and the login page offline. The update supersedes the earlier statement that there was no indication of access to session tokens. The assessment is unchanged.
